candidates.title: Roles of resonant muonic molecule in new kinetics model and muon catalyzed fusion in compressed gas
candidates.notes: Directly addresses μCF in compressed/high-density DT at T<10⁴ K and densities 10⁻³<φ<1. Discusses effective sticking W̃ₛ = ωₛ(1-R(T)) as a function of temperature and density. States sticking is 0.5% at LHD with density-dependent cycle rates up to 1.45×10⁸ s⁻¹. Full text open access via PMC.

gaps_attempted.notes: Two sources extracted that address density-dependent sticking. PMC9013384 directly models effective sticking at compressed-gas densities (φ up to 1 = LHD) and shows density and temperature dependence of reactivation. nucl-ex/0101007 is an experimental paper using solid-hydrogen multilayer films (high-density geometry) by Markushin and Petitjean. Neither source specifically addresses DAC-compressed DT at densities above LHD (Acceleron's extreme high-density regime). The gap remains partially open: the literature covers density dependence up to LHD, but Acceleron's DAC conditions may exceed LHD significantly, where reactivation physics could differ. No publication specifically addresses sticking at super-LHD densities.
